research.angle: While technologies that externalize time can reshape behavior and environmental factors like late-night work disrupt biological rhythms, the sources do not specifically confirm a neurological rewiring caused by the 19th-century shift to industrial time.
research.verdict: The evidence shows that modern environmental factors and externalized time technologies can disrupt circadian rhythms and reshape behavior, but it lacks specific data on the 19th-century industrial transition.
research.caveat: None of the sources provide historical data or neurological evidence specifically regarding the 19th-century shift from agrarian to industrial time.
